environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS with a Pod Security context and a custom OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate. The pod spec sets securityContext.seccompProfile to a custom profile (report-worker-seccomp.json) that allows read/write/open/close/stat/fstat/mmap/brk/exit_group/futex/rt_sigaction but DENIES execve, execveat, clone3 (with CLONE_THREAD only permitted), and fork/vfork. Additionally, the container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with explicit emptyDir volume mounts at /var/spool/reports and /tmp/reports only. The OPA policy also enforces that no container in the namespace may have CAP_SYS_ADMIN or CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE in its securityContext.capabilities.add list, and the PodSecurityPolicy successor (Pod Security Admission) is set to 'restricted' profile for the namespace.

config.seccomp_profile: custom: report-worker-seccomp.json - allowlist: [read, write, openat, close, stat, fstat, lstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, msync, mincore, madvise, shmget, shmat, shmctl, dup, dup2, pause, nanosleep, getitimer, alarm, setitimer, getpid, socket, connect, accept, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, getsockname, getpeername, socketpair, setsockopt, getsockopt, shutdown, fcntl, flock, fsync, fdatasync, truncate, ftruncate, getdents, getcwd, chdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, link, unlink, symlink, readlink, chmod, chown, lchown, umask, gettimeofday, getrlimit, getrusage, sysinfo, times, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, getppid, getpgrp, setsid, setpgid, getgroups, setgroups, uname, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, poll, ppoll, epoll_create1, eventfd2, timerfd_create, timerfd_settime, signalfd4, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, rt_sigreturn, sigaltstack, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, futex, clock_gettime, clock_nanosleep, exit, exit_group, wait4, tgkill, getrandom, memfd_create, copy_file_range, pread64, pwrite64, writev, readv, lseek] - DENY: [execve, execveat, fork, vfork, clone(CLONE_NEWPID|CLONE_NEWNS), ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, personality, mount, umount2, pivot_root, chroot, init_module, finit_module, delete_module, kexec_load]
config.opa_constraints: deny containers with CAP_SYS_ADMIN or CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE; deny privileged; deny hostPID/hostNetwork
